parameters.name: ContainerWebDefenseApplicationDTOS
parameters.description: The container application that is protected from being tampered with.

sub_parameters.name: ClusterId
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster to which the container belongs.

>  You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

sub_parameters.name: Flag
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to apply the configuration to the asset. Valid values:

*   **add**: applied
*   **del**: not applied

sub_parameters.name: Id
sub_parameters.description: The application ID. If the application is newly added, you do not need to specify this parameter.

sub_parameters.name: Tag
sub_parameters.description: The value of the application tag.
